en:
So an organization formed to destroy a gang has
turned into a gang itself... Ironic, I'd say.

Yeah. Since I helped organize them,
it's up to me to help shut them down.

So, what happens now?
Are you gonna try and stop them?

Now that we've meddled with their plans,
JUSTIS won't rest until we're dead.
They'll probably send the Six Lunatics after us.
The Six Lunatics...?
They're the leaders of JUSTIS.

In order to strengthen the organization, Okada
threw some money around and brought them in.

They might be strong, but they all
have some kinda shady past.

Ever since they joined, JUSTIS has steadily
transformed into a terrible gang.

The Six Lunatics, huh?
Are they really that powerful?

From what I can tell, each one of them
is just as strong a fighter as you, Kiryu-san.

Huh? As strong as Kiryu-san...?
No way...!

Didn't you see him fight?
You did see him fight, didn't you?

Why did we have to make enemies outta
those guys!? We'll never win against them!

You're the one who started it! I thought you
didn't wanna back down, no matter what!
The Six Lunatics...

My dear Six Lunatics. We are all present, yes?
It seems we've run into a minor snag.

What kinda snag're you talkin' about?
Just get on with it. I'm busy here.

Did the cops nab one of our boys?
I'm right, ain't I?

You're in for a real bruisin'
if that's all this is, Komei.
It's because of Joe.
Hm? How did you know that?

I heard you put a crew together
and went to go take him out.

What were you thinking, Komei?
That's not your call to make.

Okada told us to leave Joe alone.
You in the habit of disobeying orders now?

Let's cool it, guys.
It's no problemo.

People've gotta pay the price for cutting
ties with an organization like us.

That applies to Joe, too. He might be a founder,
but he doesn't get a free pass.

JUSTIS is a huge organization, remember.
We've gotta set the right example.

You've got a point there. So?
What's this little snag we hit?
In short...

Joe managed to defeat a large squadron
I had sent out to destroy him.

After his defection, Joe returned
to his hometown of Onomichi.

It appears as though some local friends
of his helped push our forces back.

This is no minor snag, Komei.
It's a total failure.
You're draggin' the JUSTIS name through the mud!
M-My apologies...
Here are some funds.
Sorry, but I need you down in Onomichi.

C'mon, me again?
Guess I can't say no, though.

But if there's any cash left... 
I'm ain't gonna hesitate to hit the town.

Fine by me. However... You're one of
the Six Lunatics. Failure isn't an option.

If ya screw this one up,
I'll be happy to kick your ass.

What he means is, you're outta the group
if you fail. Them's JUSTIS rules.

I already know that, so shut the hell up.
Don't recall asking for a reminder.

Welp, guess I'll start packin' my things.
Maybe I should get a travel book!
You really messed this up, Joe...
You wanna form a new team!?

Yeah. JUSTIS is gonna send the Six Lunatics
after us, without a doubt.

If we want to fight them off, we'll need to
gather an army and form a defense force.

Right... I guess we can't turn back now.
Let's do it! My mind's made up!

All right, let's make a new team with Joe as our
leader! We're gonna be even bigger than JUSTIS!
No, I'm no leader anymore.
Huh? But then...
Y-You can't mean...

Kiryu-san.
Will you be our leader?
You want me?

Yeah. JUSTIS is massive, so we're gonna need
a team just as big if we want to fight them.
I'm not too keen on managing people, though.
Besides, I'm responsible for this in the first place.

With me at the helm... there's no way we'd ever
be able to actually bring JUSTIS down.

Plus, we almost definitely would've lost that
battle earlier if we didn't have your leadership.

If we wanna win...
We need your guidance, Kiryu-san!
Please... Lend us your strength!

I appreciate the offer, but there are other
things I need to be taking care of right now.

To be honest... I just don't have the time
for this conflict of yours.
I figured you would say that.

But it really would be better if you stuck
around with us, Kiryu-san!
And why's that?

Because, well... JUSTIS is gonna stop
at nothing now to make sure you end up dead.

They'll keep sending team after team
of men to hunt you down.

You can't take them all on alone.
Even you would wear down eventually.
Kiryu-san... Sorry for dragging you into this.
But I agree with Masao.

You should probably stay with us...
At least to protect yourself from them.
Come on...

Please. I know you're busy, but I need to set
things right. I need to wake Okada up.

He's, well... He's my best friend. I know he's
lost sight of his goals, but I can't abandon him.
That hits close to home...

All right, then. I'll help you out.
Now lift your head back up.
Seriously!? This is great, Joe-san!

As you said, it would be a real problem
if I had to deal with JUSTIS alone.

Besides... I can understand how you
might feel about that friend of yours.

Kiryu-san... Thanks a ton. With you by
our side... this team's gonna be unstoppable!

All right! We're gonna make the best team
ever with Kiryu-san as our leader!

Oh! What do we wanna do about our name?
Something cool would be good, right?
Wait, we need a name?

Think about it. Every famous team
has to be recognizable somehow.

We've gotta make sure ours is good, though.
Maybe we could use English like JUSTIS did...
Hm... We should probably let our leader decide.

Yeah. You're the head of our team, Kiryu-san,
so our name should represent that somehow.

We could go with K-2016. Or the Kiryu Revolution
Army! That might be too old-school, though...
Hm... A team name that includes my own...
What about the Kiryu Clan?
K-Kiryu Clan?

What's wrong with that? I thought these kinds
of groups were always clans or families.
It's not that weird, really.

Y-Yeah, I guess you're not wrong...
But it's pretty yakuza sounding...

Well, I think it's great.
Our leader has some excellent taste.
You can't be serious...

This is the beginning of the Kiryu Clan,
the ones who will bring JUSTIS to its knees.

Not only are we gonna protect our hometown
of Onomichi... But we're gonna wake Okada up, too!
Heh... Here goes nothing...

So... I know I'm the team leader,
but what exactly does that entail?

Give us orders in battle, Kiryu-san.
Just like what you did for us earlier.

Beyond that... It's up to you
to organize the Kiryu Clan.
Organize it...?

Yes. We don't have many members at the moment,
but we'll start growing any minute now.

And when we do, we'll need a strong leader to
keep things orderly. That's where you come in.

You'll need to put your strength to good use and
organize the team to be most efficient, Kiryu-san.
Hey, why do I have to do everything...?

Don't worry about it. Just make positions
and assign people like at a company.

I don't really understand how that stuff works...
But it would be great if you could do it!
But I have a pretty biased understanding of the world.

Anyway, I'll probably structure our team based on
my former workplace. Think that would be okay?

Yeah, whatever you wanna do! By the way,
Kiryu-san, where exactly did you work?
Heh... Best that you don't know.

Oh yeah? Eh, fine by me.
Now then, it's up to you to organize the Kiryu Clan!

If you ever want to start a mission or change
the team structure, just let me know.

This is real bad, Kiryu-san!
JUSTIS is sending a swarm of guys our way!
So they're finally fighting back.

There shouldn't be too many here yet.
Let's attack now while we still can.
Totally! We're gonna wreck 'em!
All right... Let's move.

Look at how many guys they've
already sent down here...

Compared to the full JUSTIS
numbers, this is nothing.

If we can't win this little skirmish,
the war is good as lost.

I already knew they were strong...
but JUSTIS is even tougher than I imagined.

Maybe, but we still have to take them down.
It doesn't matter who they are.
That's what men do, right?
Yeah, something like that.

Anyway, that's enough talk.
Come on... Let's do this!
Gotcha!

Aw yeah! Kiryu-san, Joe-san!
We did it!

Looks like we're at least strong enough
to take down some two-bit thugs.

Bravo, bravo!
Excellent work, you guys!
That voice...
I knew it... Yano.
Long time no see, Joe-kun.

Didn't think you'd go runnin' back home.
Kinda pathetic, don't ya think?
Who is this guy?
So you're old man Kiryu, huh?

Nice to meet ya! I'm one of the most
talented producers for JUSTIS.
Toru Yano!

That's my name.
It's a pleasure to meet ya.
What's this guy's deal?

He's one of the Six Lunatics, Toru Yano. He's
called the "raid commander" over at JUSTIS.

He used to be an expert thief and fraudster,
at least until Okada took him in.

Now he's the guy in charge of all their petty crimes.
A horrible, deceitful man, if you ask me.

Whoa, whoa, whoa! That's pretty
nasty stuff to say about an old friend.
Besides, I thought I just said I'm a producer.

I work day and night producin' methods for
the younger boys to bring in cash.
Producer, my ass.

You know how many people've gotten
sent to prison because of you?

Don't gimme that!
You're thinking too small!

The only reason JUSTIS is profitin' is
because I'm rakin' in the dough, right?

I don't care about their profits.
You're here to fight us, aren't you?

Now, now. Chill out, bro. I just got here.
I'm not lookin' to fight just yet.

I mean, it's my first time in Onomichi. I was
thinkin' I'd grab some ramen and take in the sights.

I'm down to spare you guys...
For the time bein'.

By the way, these fools you just beat
were just a nice little sampler for ya.

From now on it's going to
be wave after wave.

Hope ya tire yourselves out tryin'
to deal with all of 'em.

And once you're nice n' exhausted,
I'll come in and take out the trash.
You bastard...!

I ain't like the other Lunatics. I'm smart, y'know.
That's just how I do things.

Anyway, try to stay alive 'til
I'm ready for ya, okay?

That guy really pisses me off.
Is he seriously that tough?

He is. His appearance hides his true skill.
If we want to beat him, we'll need to prepare.
Hot damn, you guys're kinda tough.

Oh! Glad you remembered me.
That's my name.
Sorry to keep ya waitin', Kiryu-san!
I wasn't holding my breath.

C'monnn, man. Eh, whatevs.
I just stopped by today for my last warning.

My whirlwind tour of Onomichi's finally over.
It's goddamn beautiful here.

Makes sense that your bastard friend Joe
would run for his life to a place like this.

I wish I could relax a bit more, but the Lunatics
keep yappin' about how I need to hurry things up.

Next time we meet, you're gonna be up against me.
That'll be the day y'all die.

Ya better be ready for the Six Lunatics.
The hammer of JUSTIS is comin' down on you!

You're not gonna know what hit ya!
Fools!
So Yano is our next opponent...

Yeah. He's strong, but the Kiryu Clan
has grown a lot stronger lately, too.
Let's take him down, Kiryu-san.
Toru Yano... He's no ordinary man.

It's finally time for our fight against Yano.
He's gonna be miles ahead of our competition so far.
Kiryu-san... Let's give this all we've got!

Yeah, let's get going. It's time we show
him what true strength looks like.
It's about time y'all showed, Kiryu Clan.
I hope you're ready for us!

If we manage to bring Yano down, that should
strike a huge blow right to the heart of JUSTIS.

Beating one of the Six Lunatics will be
a stepping stone for our future.

If we can win this... who knows what'll happen.
Let's give this everything we have, Kiryu-san.

Yeah. We've let this guy run his mouth at us
for long enough. It's time we shut him up.
Y'all ready? We are...
Kill them all!

Here we go. Kiryu Clan, move out!
Let's do this!
Hell yeah!

I don't get it...
We had way more guys than you.

You've lost, Yano. This town is our home.
Now take your men and get out of here.
It ain't gonna be that easy to make me leave.

Loss isn't an option for one of the Six Lunatics.
If I went back now, they'd totally kick me out!

Sorry, but I'm gonna have to kick your
guys' asses. That's my only choice.

Playtime's over, buddy. Time to show ya
the real might of the Six Lunatics!
Here I come!

The hell, man?
How're you so strong?

Hell yeah! We beat one of the Six Lunatics!
We took down Yano!

Mhm. I bet this'll ruffle
JUSTIS's feathers a bit.
You really think losing Yano'll make us sweat?

If anything... you're the hombre
under pressure here, Joe.
